en: It is 2021, and Nora, an autistic Jewish 18-year-old who loves art, is reeling from her mother's death from Covid-19. She travels to Paris, and in the French countryside she slips back in time to 1946, where she finds herself a patient at the asylum of Saint-Alban. There she makes friends with Beryl and Penella, meets a kind boy called Adrien, and starts to ask what it means to be truly understood. A quiet, introspective time-slip novel about grief, family trauma and love, and a 2026 US National Book Award finalist. For thoughtful readers of 14 and up.
zh: 2021年，18歲嘅Nora係一個熱愛藝術、有自閉症嘅猶太女仔，啱啱因新冠失去媽媽。佢去咗巴黎，點知喺法國鄉郊竟然穿越返1946年，變咗Saint-Alban精神病院嘅病人。喺嗰度佢識咗Beryl同Penella兩個朋友，又遇到溫柔嘅男仔Adrien，慢慢諗：俾人真正明白係點樣嘅感覺？呢本安靜、內省嘅穿越小說，講喪親之痛、家族創傷同愛，入圍2026年美國國家圖書獎。適合14歲以上讀者。

reviews.d: Starred review: a beautifully written, deeply introspective portrait of generational trauma, and of how love can both hurt and heal.
reviews.dz: 星級書評：文筆優美、深刻內省，寫出跨代創傷，同愛點樣傷人又療癒。

reviews.d: An ambitious, immersive picture of a neurodivergent teen's experience that raises thought-provoking questions about time, love and relationships.
reviews.dz: 野心十足、令人投入，寫活神經多樣少女，引人思考時間、愛同關係。

reviews.d: Starred review of the week: a quiet, singular novel in which Nora's time with the asylum patients becomes a kind of healing.
reviews.dz: 本週星級推介：安靜又獨特，Nora同病人相處嘅日子成為一種療癒。

ken: A haunting time-slip into 1946 France with a heroine who sees the world her own way.
kzh: 穿越返1946年法國，跟住一個用自己方式睇世界嘅女主角，餘韻好長。
